summary: Admitted the twenty-six corrections the Part 1 candidate record of 2026-09-17 confirmed and the confirmation review of 2026-09-18 upheld: twelve in the Azure owner or its fixtures, thirteen in the common forge contracts, and one re-owned to Plans/Forge_Integrations.md. Two merges fold seven propositions into two corrections. TA-002 was reclassified to a decision card and is not landed here. NEW-01 was withdrawn by the confirmation review.
Recorded Jared's nine answers of 2026-09-18 to the Part 1 questions as answered questions q-008 to q-016, each citing the answers file by path and SHA-256 with the relay caveat.

Compiled the twenty-six corrections into ADO-001 to ADO-005, FGI-003, FGI-004, FGI-005, FGI-007, FGI-015 and SCS-016, with the common forge schema, the source control schema and four fixture packs as companion outputs. Six new positives and seventeen new negatives were authored in the common pack, and four new negatives plus one new positive in the Azure pack.
Recorded Jared's answer of 2026-09-18, verbatim "agree", to all seven Azure decision cards as answered questions q-001 to q-007.

Compiled the seven card answers as DL-059 to DL-065 in both Decision Log sections and as the PlanUnits their owners hold: ADO-006 and ADO-007, SCS-023, F3-561, and FGI-018, FGI-019 and FGI-020. The branch-policy read is deferred and deliberately receives no PlanUnit.

Derived files regenerated, contracts gate, named tests, configured shards, plan index and the compile witness run. Three questions stay open and none blocks landing: q-017 the second research pass, q-018 the absent status-to-policy join key, and q-019 the unwritten Azure review, policy and check fixtures. The branch stops for independent review before landing on main.
